scenes.headline: How RL ships weight deltas instead of whole checkpoints
scenes.sub: Sparse updates, delta compression and async rollouts across regions.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Lime! Reinforcement learning is supposed to need one giant co-located cluster. Fireworks argues it doesn't. Here's the mechanism.

scenes.text: More than 98% of weights stay bit-identical between adjacent RL checkpoints, so ship a ~2% delta, not the full ~1 TB, on every update.
scenes.say: The idea: more than ninety-eight percent of weights stay bit-identical between neighbouring checkpoints. So ship the two percent that changed, not the whole terabyte.

scenes.title: Two jobs, joined by a delta chain

steps.say: The trainer runs forward, backward and the optimizer. It wants dense, tightly coupled hardware.
The rollout fleet samples from the current policy. That's inference, and it can live anywhere.
Each update lands in shared object storage as a small delta, and every region pulls the same chain.

steps.note: no direct connection back to the trainer
steps.say: No region talks to the trainer, so clusters can join or leave while tracking the same updates.

items.say: Keep only the chunks that changed since the last checkpoint.
Bit-pack them, with the previous snapshot's id and a checksum.
Each region rebuilds the exact checkpoint, checks it, and swaps the weights in place.
Every twenty-five steps in the sample, a full checkpoint resets the chain.

scenes.label: less cross-region weight traffic over a 50-step window
scenes.say: In Fireworks' sample setup, that cuts cross-region weight traffic by about ninety-four percent over fifty steps.

scenes.title: Why the delta size decides async RL

left.title: Taking turns
left.say: Taking turns keeps rollouts on-policy, but leaves samplers idle while weights move.

right.title: Asynchronous RL
items: Works only if the delta hides behind generation
right.say: Async RL overlaps the two and accepts a little staleness. It only works because the delta is small enough to hide.

scenes.text: If the weights barely change between updates, the mega-cluster was never load-bearing for RL.

recap: Ship checksummed deltas through shared storage
Small deltas let rollouts run async, anywhere
scenes.say: To recap: sparse updates, checksummed deltas, and rollouts that run asynchronously, anywhere.
